notes: exes: process names to search for inside the install folder (first match wins). steam: Steam app id. epic: substring of the Epic manifest AppName/DisplayName. riot: Riot product id. dirs: fallback install folders (env vars expanded). tips: short, verified in-game guidance.

games.name: Fortnite
tips: NVIDIA Reflex: On + Boost if you are CPU-limited, On if GPU-limited.
Performance mode (DirectX 11-based, low-detail meshes) gives the highest FPS on mid/low-end PCs; DirectX 12 is better on high-end GPUs and supports Reflex/DLSS.
Turn off Motion Blur and set the frame rate limit to Unlimited or just under your sustained FPS.
Pre-compile shaders by staying in the lobby a minute after each update to avoid first-match stutter.

games.name: VALORANT
tips: NVIDIA Reflex: On + Boost. Valorant is almost always CPU-limited.
Limit FPS Always: off, or set it slightly below what you can sustain — never let it bounce off a GPU limit.
Multithreaded Rendering: On. Raw Input Buffer: On (for 1000 Hz+ mice).
Vanguard requires TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot on Windows 11 — Falcon never touches these.

games.name: Counter-Strike 2
tips: NVIDIA Reflex: Enabled + Boost.
Use exclusive fullscreen; set Max FPS in-game to 0 or to a stable value with fps_max.
Launch options worth keeping: none are required anymore — -high, -threads and -tickrate are ignored or obsolete in CS2.

games.name: Apex Legends
tips: NVIDIA Reflex: Enabled + Boost.
Use the DirectX 12 client (r5apex_dx12.exe) — it is now the default and has better frametimes.
Set an FPS cap with the +fps_max launch option a few FPS below your sustained rate.

games.name: Overwatch 2
tips: NVIDIA Reflex: Enabled + Boost.
Frame rate: Custom, set ~3 FPS below what you can always hold; Triple Buffering: Off; Reduce Buffering: On (non-Reflex GPUs).

games.name: Call of Duty
tips: NVIDIA Reflex: On + Boost.
Ricochet anti-cheat requires TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot — keep them on.
Turn off On-Demand Texture Streaming if you have a slow connection; it streams textures during matches.

games.name: Rainbow Six Siege X
dirs: %ProgramFiles(x86)%\Ubisoft\Ubisoft Game Launcher\games\Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege
tips: Use the Vulkan build if it gives you steadier frametimes; enable Reflex On + Boost.

games.name: Rocket League
tips: Uncap FPS or cap at a stable value above your refresh rate; turn off V-Sync and Motion Blur.

games.name: League of Legends
tips: League uses TCP for some traffic — the Nagle/delayed-ACK tweak (Network) actually applies here.
Set the frame rate cap to Uncapped or a stable value; disable V-Sync.

games.name: Dota 2
tips: Use Vulkan or DirectX 11 — whichever gives steadier frametimes on your GPU.

games.name: PUBG: Battlegrounds
tips: Use DirectX 11 Enhanced; Reflex On + Boost.

games.name: Marvel Rivals
tips: NVIDIA Reflex: On + Boost; disable Motion Blur and Frame Generation for competitive play (Frame Gen adds latency).

games.name: Deadlock
tips: NVIDIA Reflex: On + Boost.

games.name: THE FINALS
tips: NVIDIA Reflex: On + Boost; frame generation off for competitive play.

games.name: Rust
tips: Rust is heavily CPU/memory-bound: XMP/EXPO and fast RAM matter more than GPU settings.

games.name: GTA V
tips: The Enhanced edition supports DirectX 12, DLSS/FSR and ray tracing; Legacy is lighter on old hardware.
